name: pi-durable-sessions
description: pi-sessions rebuilt on pi-durable: the agent runs inside the Session cell, no host process

scripts.reference: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly build-docs packages/client/openapi.json -o docs/api-reference.html --disableGoogleFont
scripts.check: pnpm run check:release && pnpm run check:ops && pnpm -r run check
scripts.check:ops: node --test ops/pids.test.ts && tsc -p ops && if ! command -v shellcheck >/dev/null; then echo 'shellcheck not found: install it (pacman -S shellcheck, apt install shellcheck, brew install shellcheck)' >&2; exit 1; fi && shellcheck install.sh
